name: paywall
summary: Animated paywall, free-trial timeline, success and win-back screens.
props: Gradient card + plan picker, dark full-bleed with an annual toggle, or how the free trial works.
Shown on the card and the glow pill.
{ id, label, price, period, caption?, badge?, trialDays?, cta? }. In glow the toggle picks plans[0] (on) or plans[1] (off).
trial: the “remind me” switch (controlled with onReminderChange).
Space above the restore / close buttons, e.g. useSafeAreaInsets().top. Also on PaywallSuccess and PaywallWinback.
Space under the button, e.g. useSafeAreaInsets().bottom + 12.
behavior: The aurora drifts on three loops of different lengths, a sheen sweeps the card, rows rise in one after another and prices slide when the plan changes. Springs are critically damped — nothing bounces.
Drag the card to tilt it; it springs flat when you let go. Plan tiles and rows scale down slightly on press.
Loops, tilt, lifts and press scaling are off; fades and colour changes stay. Confetti fires fewer pieces.
Plans and reasons are radio groups and the card reads as one label.

Restore sits top-left and close top-right, clear of the button. The button bar stays pinned and content fades out under it. Pass topInset / bottomInset (e.g. from useSafeAreaInsets) for the notch and home indicator.
